metadata.label: 8gpp
metadata.set_relationship: ACCURACY-GATE SET, a SEPARATE DIRECTORY from examples/benchmark_sequences/, selected with BOLTZ2_BENCHMARK_DIR (not BOLTZ2_BENCHMARK_SET) because it differs from the timing instrument by RECIPE, not by coverage. Same six targets as the 'fast' set in the sibling directory, same reference structure (data/references/8gpp.cif) — the only change is the request recipe, which here matches harness.ACCURACY_GATE_RECIPE exactly (served defaults plus use_msa_server=true), so harness._check_structure_accuracy grades these cases instead of abstaining on them. Chosen as the SAME six rather than a new set of targets because the complex_plddt floors in tuning.yaml (PLDDT_MEAN_FLOOR, PLDDT_PER_CASE_FLOOR) were themselves derived on exactly these six at exactly this recipe, so grading them again is a regression check against that derivation, not a new claim about unseen targets.

accuracy.reason: This fixture's recipe matches harness.ACCURACY_GATE_RECIPE exactly (use_msa_server=true, and every other field left at the served default), so harness._check_structure_accuracy grades it: the reported Ca-RMSD and complex_plddt count toward structure_accuracy / confidence_regression, they do not land under the ungraded_* keys.

recipe.purpose: ACCURACY-GATE INSTRUMENT, NOT THE TIMING SET. This case requests the same configuration the AIM serves by default, plus use_msa_server=true — exactly harness.ACCURACY_GATE_RECIPE. It exists so the gate has at least one case set it can grade rather than abstain on; see tests/unit/test_accuracy_gate_fixtures.py.
recipe.source: harness.ACCURACY_GATE_RECIPE (= harness.SERVED_REQUEST_DEFAULTS with use_msa_server forced to true), image/src/harness.py.
recipe.msa: use_msa_server=true IS the point of this set: every number PLDDT_MEAN_FLOOR / PLDDT_PER_CASE_FLOOR / RMSD_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD_A rest on was measured with an MSA, and a gate that graded single-sequence predictions against MSA-derived floors would be grading the wrong configuration.
recipe.diverges_from_serving_defaults: NONE besides use_msa_server, which IS the one declared departure ACCURACY_GATE_RECIPE itself specifies. sampling_steps, recycling_steps, diffusion_samples and step_scale are all OMITTED here so the service applies its own served defaults — the opposite of the timing set, which pins every one of those fields to the published performance-testing recipe.
